title: The Galápagos Islands: where Darwin saw nature change
goal: Say what was done to the Galápagos and what Darwin observed there, using the passive with ser.
grammar: the passive with ser + past participle

items: I can say what was done to a place with the passive (*fue declarada*, *fueron creadas*).
I can say what Darwin did in the Galápagos and how the islands are protected today.
I can use the new words for the islands: *archipiélago*, *especie*, *pinzón*, *iguana*.
